species_preset.species: badger (Meles meles / Taxidea taxus). Brand is a badger x wolf substrate self; the pure badger vector is in force — the wolf blend is future work (presets-titan-batch1.md §2).

build_facts.height: 183 cm (6'0") and mass 140 kg are the engineering draft's numbers — brand.md: the draft 'has the bones right' for building, but Brand does not fix a height/weight as identity. FLAGGED: needs Brand's/Joe's ruling before either is canon.
build_facts.build_thesis: width rather than height; broad wedge torso; short thick neck; massive forearms; low center; dense functional muscle under loose hide; stiff badger back (brand.md).

build_recipe.route: anthroforge-app core/build.py — this preset plus body.build.muscle 1.0, body.build.chest_width 1.0, s * body.build.tissue_strongman, 0.30 * body.belly.protrusion
build_recipe.tissue_scan: s in {0.35, 0.45, 0.55, 0.65}; ship the largest s with 0 flips, min-dot >= 0.01 and M4 >= 1.30 (see BRAND_BUILD.md)
build_recipe.neck_cap: body.neck.mass is CAPPED at raw 0.30 in the shipped build (vector intent 0.90, effective 0.930): over the full muscle system the neck field folds 3 throat faces at intent and only clears the fold gate at <= 0.30. Build-layer corrective — the record keeps the intent; a neck-field repair (FIX_NECK_FIELD pattern) is the owed fix. Shipped neck still measures 47.0 cm girth at base scale.

qa_gates.M4_chest_waist: >= 1.30 — the wedge must read (strongman reference band 1.30-1.45; Sen shipped 1.301)
qa_gates.fold_gate: 0 flipped body faces and min base-vs-composed normal dot >= 0.01 on the shipped float32 GLB
qa_gates.M1_neckW_headW: reported vs the hm08 head only — no badger head exists yet; the M1 gate is deferred to the head pass

parts_notes: FOREPAWS: digging foreclaws (keratin, blunt digging profile) + broadened foreplate are a part-layer variant for Brand (batch1 §2.4; brand.md: broad, thick-fingered paws). The base body keeps standard paws — NOT built in this pass.
FEET: plantigrade (brand.md) — matches the hm08 base stance; no part change.
FACIAL MASK: the badger mask is material/colour layer, not geometry (batch1 §2.4) — out of scope for a body pass.
SAGITTAL CREST: badger crest_sagittal head variant (batch1 §2.4) belongs to the head pass — no head built here.
ANATOMY PARTS: Brand's stated genital configuration (brand.md) is a swappable-parts-layer item — it is not part of the body vector and is NOT built in this pass.
species_preset.head_note: Badger head vector from presets-titan-batch1.md §2.3, derived from real Meles/Taxidea craniometry (provenance tags [D]/[E] live there; softest value: EarHeight, one Taxidea specimen). BrowProjection -30 rides as the canonical slider head.brow.projection (Sen precedent). Species anchors: ZB/L 0.62, mandible/L 0.81 (deepest jaw on the chart), muzzle fraction 0.39. NO head is built in this pass — body shapes only.
